*Symptoms (group `b3487f7aa2556cb2`):*
- 12 fires from Watcher B011R3D650X in #alert-frontend-errors, 20:24:13Z → 21:06:13Z UTC (42m00s span). All 12 from one bot, one channel, no interloper — single clean group. 10th consecutive cycle extending today's fe-errors episode (vs last cycle's "9th consecutive" in commit `10193a0`).
- Burst shape: 2 triple-bursts (3 alerts in 1m59s at 20:32-20:34Z, and 3 alerts in 2m00s at 20:44-20:46Z) + 6 singletons/spacers. Peak local density ~1/40s in those triple-bursts.
- *Burst-shape shift vs last cycle:* last cycle's headline (commit `10193a0`) was "new densest mini-burst: 6 alerts in 5m59s ~1/60s." This cycle the dense run pattern shifts to "2 short triple-bursts" at ~1/40s — per-minute peak density higher, but burst size halved (6 → 3). Worth one cycle to confirm pattern.
- *No interloper this cycle.* B063S8NBW0M (runtime-monitoring) did NOT fire — #alert-runtime-monitoring is empty for this poll window. First clean fe-errors cycle (no satellite-bot interleave, no split-artifact) in 4 cycles (last 3 cycles all had B063S8NBW0M interleaves per commits `82615e7`, `10193a0`, and the stability-review candidate noted there).

*Today's episode aggregate (fe-errors, 12:07:13Z → 21:06:13Z UTC):*
- 70 alerts / 8h59m. Derivation: 58 alerts/7h51m from last cycle (commit `10193a0`) + 12 new this cycle (20:24Z-21:06Z) = 70. Span 12:07Z→21:06Z = 8h59m. New all-time high in routine memory.
- Δ vs last cycle (58 / 7h51m=471m): *+12 alerts (+20.7%), +68 min (+14.4%)*.
- Cycle-by-cycle deltas (from prior 5 commit messages): `5-ago→4-ago: +43%/+24% • 4→3: +33%/+30% • 3→2: +10%/+18% • 2→1: +5%/+9% (decel) • 1→last: +26%/+25% (re-accel) • last→this: +21%/+14%`. Re-acceleration trend persists at n=2 above the +9% decel floor, but slope is shallowing again.

Trace IDs: n/a (no telemetry)
Likely cause: unknown — same 3-hypothesis space as prior 10 cycles (a) low-rate JS exception batch driven by external traffic, (b) noisy Watcher threshold, (c) spreading-regression. This cycle's burst-shape shift + clean group (no fan-out to other bots/channels) further weakens (b) and (c); (a) remains leading hypothesis.
Suggested next action: *unblock DD/ES creds, OR mute Watcher B011R3D650X.* 42nd consecutive DD/ES/SQL/Mongo-blocked cycle (prior cycle `10193a0` was 41st). The "burst-shape shift to triple-burst at higher density" is exactly the kind of change DD RUM faceted by account/route/error-class would let us pin to a specific signal — and exactly what we can't confirm without creds.
